decisions.decision: Board made findings (a) through (d) on public health, neighborhood value, order and sightlines, and noise/odor/glare, and specifically found the Special Permit would not contravene the Protective Bylaws or Chapter 40A.
decisions.quote: in making this determination, the board specifically found that the granting of this special permit would not contravene the purpose of the protective bylaws

decisions.decision: The Special Permit was made subject to the applicants complying with all applicable state, local and federal licenses, regulations, and ordinances, and to periodic review by the permit granting authority or Enforcement Officer.
